item.title: Wade Wilson Called His Father To Confess To Two Murders
item.description: After killing Kristine Melton and Diane Ruiz in 2019, Wade Wilson called his biological father and described what he had done. His father later testified that Wilson sounded excited and showed no remorse. He secretly contacted police and provided Wilson’s location, helping lead to his arrest.
